author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.33 shipped: One darkness setting per room
why: Merging the lighting menus left two only-when-dark controls on one form; the operator asked to dedup. The room-wide choice covers almost every room, so it stays primary and the per-light list becomes an Advanced exception with plain text explaining when it applies.
implications: Shipped ROOM-LIGHTING-SETUP-REDESIGN-1 at v5.103.33; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.33.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If anyone sets dark-only lights expecting them to work under Only when dark, reopen.

refs.release_notes: Turn lights on when someone enters: Never / Always / Only when dark is the room's darkness setting; the per-light 'Wait for dark' list is an Advanced exception used only when the room is set to Always. Labels only, no behaviour change.
